hack.root_cause: Integer Overflow / Division-by-Near-Zero in Concentrated Liquidity Math
hack.description: An attacker deposited a single token into a DEX pool with a near-zero denominator in its liquidity formula, generating 10³⁴ units of fake liquidity, and drained $223M from every pool on Sui's largest exchange.
